note: Phase 10 ownership manifest for operational backup, restore, restore verification, public route absence, deployment-local operator boundary, and backup-storage binding. Sprint 0 keeps all rows blocked until direct evidence replaces the sentinels.

ledger.title: Phase 10 Coverage Ledger
notes: Phase 10 is planned, not active, while all authoritative rows are blocker sentinels.
Every authoritative Phase 10 guide row has exactly one blocked owner so traceability exists without claiming implementation.
Operational backup and restore remain deployment-local recovery behavior and are distinct from the Incident Portability Extension Profile.
Generated ledgers and schedules are downstream artifacts and must not be hand-edited.
authoritative_execution: `backend-unit` will select direct configuration and route-inventory evidence once `U-10-04` and `U-10-05` are implemented.
`backend-store` will select retained `backup_set` metadata and retention evidence once `U-10-01` is implemented.
`backend-integration` will select real backing-storage metadata evidence once `I-10-01` is implemented.
`backend-process` will select restore, fail-closed, operator, route-inventory, and effective-config evidence once process-bound rows are implemented.
`browser-e2e-webserver-backed` will select workbook recovery evidence once `E-10-02` is implemented.
support_execution_extras: Existing runtime-root, object-store, projection, workbook, route, and browser evidence from earlier phases is support-only substrate and cannot satisfy Phase 10 rows.
shared_harness: | Planned manifest ownership | `tools/phase10_test_map.json` records every authoritative guide row as blocked until direct evidence exists. |
| Generated ledger | `docs/testing/phase10_coverage_ledger.md` is generated from this manifest and must not be hand-edited. |
| Schedule boundary | Phase 10 remains planned, so generated schedules must not treat Phase 10 rows as active executable evidence. |
support_only: Earlier phase runtime-root and object-store evidence is support-only substrate.
Existing projection rebuild tests are support-only substrate until Phase 10 restore readiness owns projection rebuild evidence.
Existing browser workbook query tests are support-only substrate until Phase 10 restore recovery evidence owns the row.

unit.claim: Retained backup_set metadata, exact verification_state vocabulary, one coherent consistency_point_at, and latest-success plus 30-day retention floors require future direct persistent-state evidence.
unit.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not implement backup metadata, retention, restore anchors, or verification-state transitions.

unit.claim: Restore readiness requires exactly one retained backup_set, same-point Postgres and object-store restore, and projection rebuild before readiness; future process-bound evidence must replace this sentinel.
unit.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not implement restore orchestration or readiness gating.

unit.claim: Restore must fail before readiness when required artifacts or integrity proof are missing, and restore verification must update state only according to isolated verification results.
unit.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not implement artifact proof checks or restore-verification state transitions.

unit.claim: Public route inventories must expose no backup, restore, or restore-verification families, and any built-in operator control must be deployment-local and deployment_admin-gated.
unit.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not provide direct route inventory or deployment-admin control evidence.

unit.claim: roots.backup_storage must be a required persistent runtime root with allowed binding kinds and must remain distinct from export and temporary-work roots.
unit.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not replace direct Phase 10 configuration-contract evidence.

integration.claim: The most recent successful retained backup_set must expose required metadata, restore anchors, retention timestamps, and verification transitions against real backing storage.
integration.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not implement or verify real backup storage metadata.

integration.claim: Restoring the latest successful retained backup_set into a fresh environment must rebuild projections, open an incident when data exists, execute a built-in workbook query, and preserve row, change-set, and blob consistency.
integration.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not perform fresh-environment restore or workbook recovery.

integration.claim: Selecting a retained backup_set missing a required artifact or integrity proof must fail before target readiness.
integration.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not create broken backup fixtures or readiness-failure evidence.

e2e.claim: A deployment-local operator must inspect the latest successful retained backup_set and see exact verification, retention, and verification timestamps.
e2e.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not implement operator inspection.

e2e.title: Phase 10 E-10-02 restore recovers workbook surface and executes a built-in workbook query
e2e.claim: Restoring the latest successful retained backup_set into a fresh deployment must recover the workbook surface and execute at least one built-in workbook query successfully.
e2e.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not run a browser-visible restore workflow.

e2e.claim: Public HTTP and WebSocket route inventories must expose no backup, restore, or restore-verification families, and any built-in operator control must remain deployment-local and deployment_admin-gated.
e2e.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not provide live route-inventory evidence.

e2e.claim: Effective deployment configuration must require roots.backup_storage with allowed binding kinds and reject attempts to satisfy backup storage with export or temporary-work roots.
e2e.out_of_scope: This sentinel does not provide effective startup rejection evidence.
